purpose: Structural consistency and selected original worked examples; no source-paper replication or proof-package replay.

checks.name: unique-record-ids
checks.detail: All source, concept and formula IDs are unique within their registry.

checks.name: formula-card-completeness
checks.detail: Required explanatory fields are nonempty; this does not certify every algebraic statement.

checks.name: four-level-taxonomy
checks.detail: All concept records have an explicit four-part navigation path.

checks.name: typed-analogies
checks.detail: Labels identifying analogies are not typed as support or prerequisite relations.

checks.name: prerequisite-graph-acyclic
checks.detail: Only prerequisite_of edges are checked; related/analogy links may intentionally form cycles.

checks.name: grounded-image-plane
checks.detail: Image pair cancels on a sampled grounded plane point.

checks.name: poisson-stencil-polynomial
checks.detail: The discrete Laplacian exactly reproduces the quadratic polynomial up to roundoff.

checks.name: sampling-alias
checks.detail: 700 Hz and 300 Hz real cosines alias at a 1000 Hz sample rate.

checks.name: allan-bias-distinction
checks.detail: Constant frequency bias has zero Allan deviation; alternating averages do not.
